subtitle: Icon tabs, grouped menus, a Hide office button, and workflows that can skip what does not apply.

cards.title: Tabs are icons, with names on hover
cards.text: A card over each tab says its name, what it is for and the key that goes to it.

cards.title: Agent and chat menus, in groups
cards.text: Each action has a line on what it does, and the key sits beside Search.

cards.title: Hide office
cards.text: Stops the picture and gives the chat the whole window; a strip brings the office back.

cards.title: Skip what does not apply
cards.text: Steps can be skipped with a reason, a refused step can be asked again, and a stuck run can be ended.

also: Cards that ask fold to a line
